description: Solve a 3D study on a part (mm) with AxenomIA’s finite-element solvers: physics one of physics.heat, physics.solid-mechanics, physics.modal, fluids.laminar-flow, fluids.turbulent-flow, physics.electric-currents, chemistry.species-transport. params: material values in the units from axenomia_capabilities. boundary: [{faces:[id | "+x" | "-z" | "curved" …], kind, value / flux / h / ambient / dir}]. Returns min / max / mean of the main field, the key results (heat flow, max von Mises, displacement, reaction, safety factor, frequencies, pressure drop, Reynolds…), the mesh used and notes on accuracy. Needs an AxenomIA API key (Authorization: Bearer).
name: axenomia_solve_study
title: Solve a 3D engineering study (finite elements)
